# BotPenguin

BotPenguin is an AI chatbot platform for managing contacts, conversations, bot integrations, and cross-platform customer messaging.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/botpenguin/.

## Actions

- **Get Template Dynamic Fields** (read-only): Return the dynamic key-value fields required by a BotPenguin WhatsApp template.
- **Import Contacts**: Import contacts in bulk into BotPenguin.
- **List Inbox Contacts** (read-only): Return one page of BotPenguin inbox contacts filtered by whether the contact has interacted with a bot.
- **List Segments** (read-only): List the contact segments configured in the connected BotPenguin account, including each segment's filter definition and contact count.
- **List WhatsApp Bots** (read-only): List WhatsApp bots available to the connected BotPenguin account for use with plugin template tools.
- **List WhatsApp Templates** (read-only): List WhatsApp templates available to a BotPenguin bot.
